WITH MonthlyUnitCost AS (SELECT month, cost_unit_id, cost_unit_full_name, SUM(real_billing_cost) AS total_cost  FROM mcmp_cost_tst.billing_item_monthly  WHERE tenant_id = 88  AND month >= CAST(DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(now(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), '%Y%m') AS INT)  AND cost_unit_id IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY month, cost_unit_id, cost_unit_full_name) SELECT this.cost_unit_full_name, (this.total_cost - last.total_cost) / last.total_cost * 100 AS mom_growth FROM MonthlyUnitCost this  JOIN MonthlyUnitCost last ON this.cost_unit_id = last.cost_unit_id AND  STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(this.month, '01'), '%Y%m%d') =  STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(last.month, '01'), '%Y%m%d') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH WHERE this.month = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(date_sub(now(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m') AS INT) AND last.total_cost > 100 ORDER BY mom_growth DESC;
